findings.claim: Envelope identity could come from a different graph realization than query data.
findings.resolution: FIXED: CodeQueryEngine now returns BuildMetadata from its pinned materialized graph or immutable store selector; MCP uses that exact invocation metadata.

findings.claim: Advertised outputSchema left nested query records unconstrained.
findings.resolution: FIXED: outputSchema now defines closed nested query records and every golden is recursively validated; malformed node payloads are rejected by the regression validator.

findings.claim: Envelope overhead could cross maxResponseBytes after query-layer enforcement.
findings.resolution: FIXED: MCP measures final structured-content bytes and fails before publishing an oversized envelope; a regression exercises the inner-pass/outer-fail boundary.

findings.claim: Legacy text tools were neither enveloped nor deprecated.
findings.resolution: FIXED: discovery descriptions and Compass metadata mark every remaining text-only result, plus query_graph text mode, deprecated from 0.4.0 without removal.

findings.claim: No independent pre-envelope golden comparison existed.
findings.resolution: FIXED: four separate compass.query/1 fixtures are compared exactly with envelope.data in addition to four full-envelope goldens.

findings.claim: The design example used confidence fields absent from implementation.
findings.resolution: FIXED: the example now uses exact, inferred, and ambiguous.
